segments.content:
Hello! I can help you explore the Midwest Airbnb listings.
  • What is the average nightly price in each city?
  • Show a bar chart comparing listing counts by city and room type
  • Which neighborhoods have the highest average prices?
  • Show the most highly reviewed listings
rank the cities by average airbnb cost

segments.intent: Rank cities by average nightly Airbnb price
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT city, ROUND(AVG(price), 0) AS average_nightly_price, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings GROUP BY city ORDER BY average_nightly_price DESC
```

<details open><summary>Result</summary>

```
         city average_nightly_price listing_count
1     Chicago                   334          7439
2 Twin Cities                   316          4861
3    Columbus                   236          2587
```

</details>
